_note: Sitting Washington, Arizona and Massachusetts state legislators, read from each chamber's official sources on 2026-10-24. cmp-data.js carries a roster shell for every "rows" entry; "districtSet" names existing records that gained their district; "nameSharedWithAnotherRecord" seats are left empty because another record carries the same display name. Washington's biennium sponsor list still carries two senators who left mid-term (Joe Nguyen, LD 34; Bill Ramos, LD 5), so a Washington senator was taken as sitting only when the Legislature's own web service lists them on an active Senate committee: every district has exactly one, and the Lieutenant Governor, who chairs Rules, was set aside. Arizona's roster marks Eva Burch (LD 9) as resigned 03/14/2025; she was left out and Kiana Sears, listed for LD 9, was kept. Massachusetts rows come from the Legislature's member pages (its API still lists four members who have left); a Massachusetts district is keyed by its name, as the seat resolver's district-name table spells it, and "district" is that table's sequence number for the seat.

notAdded.Washington House of Representatives: Each of Washington's 49 legislative districts elects two Representatives (Position 1 and Position 2). The seat resolver places nobody on a seat two in-office records claim, so a pair of shells would still read "no member on file yet"; no House rows were added.
notAdded.Arizona House of Representatives: Each of Arizona's 30 legislative districts elects two Representatives. The seat resolver places nobody on a seat two in-office records claim, so a pair of shells would still read "no member on file yet"; no House rows were added.
